title: fix(service-settings): a map setting refuses every key when its key source answers an empty list
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1nhftM2hZHHvqk2GLFyVTN)_

domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nBSzc6ktJyjdFcDb3

Fixes #31422

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (a `map` key whose key source answered an empty list was accepted at both doors and is refused now; on such a host no key could name what the setting reads)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`map` 类设置(`lifecycle.quotas` / `retention_overrides` 等)的键,按该键注册的选项来源判定。来源答了「空列表」时(例如没有任何声明 lifecycle 的对象),以前跳过键校验、任何键都存进去,`OS_*` 也照样生效;现在两道门都拒绝(保存门 `invalid_option`,环境变量门记一条 error 且不生效)。另补两个缺失的形状 pin(数组值、多列 map 里的标量条目),并把 `lifecycle-service.ts` 里仍把这些键叫 `json` 的注释改正。
- 为什么改:#31386 复审的三处非阻塞项。空列表时放行任何键,与「列表里没有的键就拒绝」不一致。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(Clause-② narrowing):只影响「来源答了空列表」的主机上非空的这些 map 值;这时没有任何键能指向清扫会读的对象。空 map 仍可保存;来源没注册或答不出时,仍按声明的选项判定,未声明选项则放行(有对照 pin)。service-settings 全量测试全绿。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` 的 `mapShapeVerdict` 与 `optionTableOf`(新增 `sourced`),`settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts` 末尾两个 `[#31422]` describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts`,预期 22 条全绿;其中 2 条在 main 上是红的。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(收窄,落地前席位做契约复审)。

## What changes

- **`SettingsService.optionTableOf`** (`service-settings`): the option table now says which table it is, `sourced: true` when a registered source answered (even with no options), `false` for the declared fallback. Its other two callers (the option-bearing save branch and the env override for non-map keys) ignore the new member and are unchanged.
- **`SettingsService.mapShapeVerdict`**: the key column's domain applies whenever a source answered (`sourced || allowed.length > 0`). The `allowed.length > 0` gate is kept only for the declared-table fallback: a key with no source, or whose source could not answer, still admits every key when it declares none. Both doors call this one verdict, so the save door (`invalid_option`, "'k' is not a key this setting admits.") and the env door (one `error` line, the override not in force) move together. The docblock states the rule.
- **`LifecycleService`** (`objectql`): comment only. The docblock at ~l.1162 now says these keys are `map` specifiers (#30208), `json` before it.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-map-shape-30208.test.ts`, 6 new rows (16 → 22):

- `[#31422] a key source that answered an empty list admits no key`, over `lifecycleObjectKeySource` on a registry with no lifecycle-declared object: the save door refuses `{ quotas: { sys_audit_log: 1000 } }` with one `invalid_option` naming the entry, nothing stored; the env door does not put `OS_LIFECYCLE_QUOTAS` in force (one error line). Controls: an empty map still saves; a source that could not answer (no registry) leaves the declared table, which declares no key, so any key passes.
- `[#31422] the two shape misses #30208 left unpinned`: an array value is `invalid_type` (`not_a_map`, "…not an array…"); a scalar entry in the several-column `retention_overrides` is `invalid_shape` (`not_an_entry`, naming the entry and `maxAge, expireAfter`). Both are coverage pins and green on main.

## Acceptance notes

- **Responsibility.** The three non-blocking nits of PR #31386's contract review (6717755004), recorded on #30208 (6717781477).
- **Narrowing, stated.** On a host whose lifecycle key source answers no objects, a non-empty `quotas` / `retention_overrides` value, saved or in `OS_LIFECYCLE_*`, was accepted and is refused now. With no lifecycle-declared object, no key could name an object the sweep reads, so nothing that worked stops working. `quota_defaults`' source (`lifecycleClassKeySource`) never answers empty.
- **Noted, not changed (out of the claim's surface).** The option-bearing save branch and the env override for non-map keys keep their own `allowed.length > 0` gate, so a select key whose registered source answers an empty list still admits any value. Same shape as item 1, on a different family; not filed.
- **Worktree.** The claim names `objectstack-issue-31422`; this ran in the chain's existing worktree `objectstack-issue-31317` on the same claimed branch, cut from fresh `origin/main` after #31480 merged.

Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob 07699b278e33 to e0d112878a7f). Pin: Tests 2 failed | 20 passed (22), the same two rows. Restored: blob == HEAD (07699b278e33), `git diff HEAD` empty.
